name: Shelah
title: Descendant of Judah
summary: Shelah (also known as Shelah) was the third son of Judah and his Canaanite wife Bath-Shua. He was promised as a husband to Tamar after his two older brothers Er and Onan died, but Judah did not keep his promise. Shelah became the ancestor of a clan within the tribe of Judah.

keyEvents.title: Shelah's Birth
keyEvents.description: Shelah was born as the third son of Judah and his Canaanite wife Bath-Shua, in Chezib.

keyEvents.title: The Promise to Tamar
keyEvents.description: After Er and Onan died, Judah promised that Shelah would be given to Tamar as a husband when he grew up, but Judah did not keep the promise because he feared that Shelah would also die.

keyEvents.title: Shelah Mentioned in Judah's Lineage
keyEvents.description: Shelah is mentioned as part of Judah's descendants who went down to Egypt with Jacob and his family.

keyEvents.title: Selek's Place in the Census
keyEvents.description: The descendants of Selek, the Shelaithites, are mentioned among the genealogies of Judah in the census on the plains of Moab.

keyEvents.title: The Descendants of Selek in Chronicles
keyEvents.description: The lineage of Selek is described in 1 Chronicles, where his descendants and their settlements are noted as part of the tribe of Judah.
